scope: DEC-04b full-input v4 validation against the unchanged real USDC v3 Registry manifest; signature verification, expiry, RPC nonce and policy verdicts are not performed.
case_input_rules: Clone defaults, set dot-separated paths (creating absent objects), remove omit paths; optionally reverse object key insertion order; optionally JSON-stringify typed_data with two-space indentation.
nonce_scope: message.nonce is the signed request value. Action.body.nonce is a zero-initialized external-read LiveField from manifest live_inputs, not an RPC result; owner is not in Action body.
